activity_summary: In the afternoon the children staged a pageant by the rain-barrel. Judith would not be the woman after being the horse. Edmund roared into the barrel, and she crowned him with the colander. You laughed until you had to hold your side, spoke four lines to ransom him with two windfalls, and did not play him any ending. Tomorrow's walk up the row stayed theirs.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Laughed, spoke the four lines, and did not give an ending.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the woman's part, took the colander, and held the ransom.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the lath, and caught the wasp-apple in the ransom.

entities.name: Edmund Shakespeare
entities.context: Roared into the barrel, and was heard as far as the barrel.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked what kind of piece it was, and kept tomorrow's count.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Got the colander back before the parsley became a household matter.

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: Why must I be the woman? I was the horse yesterday

quotes.speaker: edmund_shakespeare
quotes.text: Holla, ye pampered jades of Asia! What, can ye draw but twenty miles a day?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Not the end, and not today
